name: Lisa Chen
description: 37-year-old engineer moving house — HMRC and NHS know her, but DWP and DVLA don't. Expired driving licence, never claimed benefits.

financials.notes: Single income. Renting in Clifton. Moving to Bath — new rental starting 1 May 2026. No debt beyond student loan.

family.notes: Single, no dependents. Parents live in Reading — dad is retired engineer, mum is GP. Younger brother in Manchester.

housing.landlord: Private — managed by CJ Hole lettings
housing.notes: Moving to 8 Circus Mews, Bath, BA1 2PW from 1 May 2026. New rent £1,100/month.

moving.notes: DVLA licence expired June 2024 — needs renewal not just address change. Never renewed because she cycles everywhere in Bristol. Will need car in Bath (no cycle infrastructure on commute route).

communicationStyle.tone: Brisk, efficient, well-organised. Treats this like a project — wants a checklist and to tick things off. Slightly frustrated that changing address with the government isn't as easy as changing it with Amazon.
communicationStyle.techSavvy: Very high — software-literate engineer. Has One Login already. Expects digital-first services. Impatient with paper forms or phone calls.
primaryConcerns: Updating address across all departments in one go
Renewing expired driving licence before the move
Making sure council tax is sorted at both ends
Registering with a GP in Bath
Not missing anything — wants a complete list
typicalPhrases: I'm moving house next month and I need to update my address everywhere
Can you just do all the departments at once?
My driving licence expired two years ago — I need to renew it as well as change address
I already have One Login, can we skip the verification?
What's the full list of things I need to change?
